common_rule: 18 isolated searches, six each T/F/U, Luna high; broad mathematical approaches with precise deliverables. Primary guards and original tag semantics unchanged. Common candidates are unawarded inputs. Existing92 refutations remain binding. Modest reproducible exact foreground computation, no other agents or Lean. New auxiliary claims are proposals only. Do not infer universal truth from finite certificates.

routes.T1: Anchor the primary aggregate. Use the independently audited first-shell candidate as an explicit informal premise and develop a new shell-by-shell structural criterion for parent order2p+2+d, d>=1. Generalize the cover-three early-descent budget to a stated cover size and connect that bound to an exact marked residual sign criterion. Deliver a new sufficient sign subclass, a quantitative remaining inequality, or a counterexample to the proposed generalization. Do not spend the route repeating the supplied shell audit; new universal sublemmas remain proposals. T4 separately targets concrete d=1 residual classification.
routes.T2: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-TWO-FOR-ONE-WEIGHTED-HALL. Seek an actual weighted-cut uncrossing theorem for deletion plus two-for-one exchanges. Fix the original strict selector. Produce a proved reduction to a tractable cut family or a capacitated injection; identify any exact missing lemma. Study whether tree branch factorization controls crossing cuts. Repeating max-flow/min-cut or checking only total mass is insufficient.
routes.T3: Anchor the registered TWO-FOR-ONE-WEIGHTED-HALL mechanism. Seek a symmetric-chain, discrete Morse, alternating-path or exchange construction on independent sets that moves across selected leaf tags and proves capacities. State a concrete map, collision bound and recovery rule, or explicit failure. Homotopy alone supplies no layer inequality. Test the known deletion-only failures and a new larger actual eligible tree.
routes.T4: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-ORDINARY-FAVORABLE-LEAF-AGGREGATE. Investigate n=2p+3, the next parent order after the supplied first-shell candidate. First-mark residuals may have order2k+1: classify the remaining graph/cover configurations and prove a genuine sign subclass or quantified sufficient compensation. Do not reuse a size2k theorem at size2k+1. Exact new universal sublemmas are proposals only.
routes.T5: Anchor the primary aggregate. Seek a coefficient proof for the entire infinite T_m root/path/three-leaf-claw family, under the actual early-descent and strict favorable guards. Use the supplied exact polynomials and finite controls; separate arm and claw selector cases instead of assuming all leaves favorable. Try binomial-mixture or likelihood-ratio comparisons with proved hypotheses, not assumed log-concavity. Deliver an infinite-family theorem or the precise coefficient inequality left open.
routes.T6: Anchor the primary aggregate. Build a rooted-tree potential that couples selected negative budget to positive local terms, with exact recurrence under one specific branch composition. Retain the full fixed-rank original selector and x. Prove a nontrivial closure rule or give a counterexample to the potential; the polynomial recurrence alone is already known.
routes.F1: Anchor TWO-FOR-ONE-WEIGHTED-HALL. Run bounded literal-set flow tests on the supplied4991 eligible p7 trees at orders16..18, or a explicitly selected reproducible subset if all are infeasible. Preserve known census counts separately from the flow horizon. Return the first exact deficient cut, or exact feasible certificates with integer capacities and arc validation. Optimize reuse of graph bitmasks. Do not rerun the census generator unnecessarily. Failure of this mechanism is not S>0.
routes.F2: Anchor TWO-FOR-ONE-WEIGHTED-HALL and primary. Analyze CB(8,92) plus a genuinely larger eligible choked-broom perturbation. Account for all new two-for-one arcs, especially one-support branch exports; old tag-closed cuts are not cuts in this graph. Give an exact cut deficit or proved subfamily routing and quantify the uncovered remainder. Reconstruct actual order, alpha, terminal x, selector and full S. The supplied CB envelope is inconclusive, not a refutation.
routes.F3: Anchor TWO-FOR-ONE-WEIGHTED-HALL. Search asymmetric realizable trees for deficient cuts beyond the small census, using exact orbit quotients only when justified or literal sets when feasible. Target unbalanced supports, interrupted paths and selector losses. Provide a graph recipe, every guard and complete S for any witness, and distinguish a mechanism counterexample from a target counterexample.
routes.F4: Anchor FIRST-ORDER-SHELL-POINTWISE-EARLY-DESCENT. Attack the new proof at the marked-cover lemma, two-vertex deletion, all-ranks Catalan floor and leaf-cover bridge; test small and degenerate cases without the alpha/favorable guards. Then test the proposed next-order n=2p+3 extension for an actual early-descent positive local term. A positive ineligible star is only hypothesis sharpness, not a refutation.
routes.F5: Anchor TWO-FOR-ONE-WEIGHTED-HALL. Construct weighted capacity bottlenecks from heterogeneous rooted branches: hubs with different arm lengths, claw sizes and occupancy modes. Test actual allowed moves and selector. Seek a cut obstruction or structural failure of a claimed sufficient rule. Avoid convex hulls of already-negative full sums and nonrealizable coefficient arrays.
routes.F6: Anchor the primary aggregate. Use a specific graft/gluing family that changes the favorable selector, targeting destruction of compensating tags while preserving x+2<=p and strict lower-region alpha guard. Derive all original-leaf maps and full S exactly. A preserved positive single-tag term is insufficient. Deliver an eligible full-sum witness or a proved family obstruction.
routes.U1: Anchor TWO-FOR-ONE-WEIGHTED-HALL. Audit its exact relationship to all92 inherited refutations, original Delete/Retag and weighted deletion-only graphs. Prove the clone projection and strict enlargement with actual examples, then identify the minimal additional edges that repair known cuts and whether other cuts remain. Do not turn failed old mechanisms into a new verdict or state full-upper cut equivalence to scalar S.
routes.U2: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-AGGREGATE-RANK-LE-SEVEN. Independently audit every rank/order case in the proposed composition using the registered forest M(1..5), order-band proof, p6 census and all three p7 slices. Check terminal x, empty/K1 cases, global ceiling versus finite horizon, actual generation boundaries and exact disjoint counts. Give a complete proof at census-dependent grade or an exact gap. F3 mislabelled shell rows are excluded.
routes.U3: Anchor FIRST-ORDER-SHELL-POINTWISE-EARLY-DESCENT. Produce a minimal Lean-ready dependency DAG for the marked cover argument and cover-three early-descent contradiction. Compare direct marked A/B/C decomposition with first-mark partition; audit all external theorem scopes against registry. Retain negative-index zero extension, arbitrary earlier marks, and exact tree bridges. Do not build Lean or assert a formal award.
routes.U4: Anchor TWO-FOR-ONE-WEIGHTED-HALL. Analyze its exact capacitated cut dual and seek a proved reduction using product structure, compression, submodularity or colored shadows. Every compression must preserve total supply/capacity and legal neighborhoods with fixed selector; give a finite obstruction when it fails. A tautological LP restatement is not progress. Primary literature can guide a concrete reduction with all hypotheses checked.
routes.U5: Anchor the primary aggregate. Use the first strict descent x<=p-2 as a genuine inequality at an earlier layer and transfer it into a selected-tag deficit budget. Seek a theorem tying cover size, rank and selector through exact binomial components or conditional occupancy. No recovery/unimodality assumption. Deliver an explicit conditional bridge with independent antecedents, not the primary rewritten as its own premise.
routes.U6: Anchor the primary aggregate. Investigate a concrete graded weighted complex/rank operator with topology, representation theory or probability. Specify the spaces, maps and an exact dimension/rank or expectation inequality that would imply S<=0; prove a nontrivial case or expose a tested obstruction. Check every Lefschetz, negative-dependence, real-rootedness or matroid premise against tree counterexamples; no qualitative analogy as a theorem.
